messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Rosuvastatin (Crestor) is a prescription medicine.
The medicine is used to treat high cholesterol.
The medicine is used to reduce the risk of major cardiovascular events.
Major cardiovascular events include heart attack and stroke.
Rosuvastatin belongs to a class of medicines called statins.
Rosuvastatin works by blocking HMG-CoA reductase.
HMG-CoA reductase is the rate-limiting enzyme the liver uses to make cholesterol.
With cholesterol synthesis reduced, the liver increases its LDL receptors.
The liver clears more LDL from the blood.
LDL is "bad" cholesterol.
LDL and total cholesterol levels fall.
The maximum reduction is usually reached by four weeks.
Rosuvastatin comes as a tablet.
Rosuvastatin was first approved by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) on August 12, 2003, under the brand name Crestor.
Many generic versions of rosuvastatin tablets have since been approved.
Triplet: ["Rosuvastatin", "has fda approval date", "August 12, 2003"]

The relation 'has fda approval date' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug was first approved by the FDA on the date specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'fda approval year': The subject drug was approved by the US FDA in the year specified by the object entity.
B. 'is approved for': The subject drug has received FDA approval for the medical condition or indication specified by the object entity.
C. 'has availability date': The subject drug has been available since the time period specified by the object entity.
D. 'has onset of effect': The subject drug starts to work or shows its effect within the time period specified by the object entity.
E. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
